Requirement: The 95th percentile server response time for a filtered request list of up to 500 records shall not exceed 2.0 seconds with 10 concurrent users on a warm instance.
Acceptance criteria: A load test of 10 concurrent users over 5 minutes against a 500-record data set reports a 95th percentile response time of 2.0 seconds or less. Cold-start latency is measured and reported separately (see NFR-002).

Requirement: The staging deployment shall be available at least 95% of the time between 07:00 and 18:00 SAST on weekdays across the M3 evaluation period. Cold-start latency of up to 30 seconds after idle is a declared and accepted limitation of the free-tier hosting constraint.
Acceptance criteria: An uptime log across the evaluation period shows availability of 95% or more within the stated window, and the observed cold-start latency is recorded as a known limitation in the PED.

Requirement: Passwords shall be stored only as a salted adaptive hash (bcrypt with cost factor 10 or greater, or Argon2id). No password shall be stored in plaintext or in any reversible form.
Acceptance criteria: Inspection of the stored user records shows no plaintext or reversible password value, and code review confirms the hashing algorithm and cost factor.

Requirement: 100% of role-restricted operations shall reject a request from an unauthorised role with an authorisation error and without any state change.
Acceptance criteria: An automated test matrix covering every role against every restricted operation reports zero unauthorised successes.
Verification method: Automated role x operation matrix test, M3

Requirement: No password, API key, token, connection string or private key shall be present in the repository or in its commit history.
Acceptance criteria: An automated secret scan on every pull request and a full-history scan both report zero findings.

Requirement: 100% of status and assignment changes shall be recorded with actor, UTC timestamp, previous value and new value, and shall not be modifiable through the application.
Acceptance criteria: For a scripted sequence of k changes, the audit record contains exactly k entries with all four fields populated, and no application endpoint accepts an update or delete against an audit entry.

Requirement: An untrained Requester shall complete a valid submission within 3 minutes and no more than 3 screens.
Acceptance criteria: In a moderated test with 5 representative participants, at least 4 complete a valid submission unaided within 3 minutes.

Requirement: Body text shall meet a contrast ratio of at least 4.5:1, every form input shall carry a programmatic label, and the submission flow shall be fully keyboard operable (WCAG 2.1 AA subset).
Acceptance criteria: An automated accessibility check reports zero contrast or missing-label violations on the submission and request-detail screens, and the submission flow is completed using keyboard input only.
Verification method: Automated accessibility scan + manual keyboard walkthrough, M3

Requirement: Automated unit tests shall cover at least 70% of lines in the business/service layer, and static analysis shall report zero critical findings on the main branch.
Acceptance criteria: The pipeline coverage report shows 70% or more line coverage for the business/service layer and the static-analysis stage reports zero critical findings.

Requirement: Recurring monetary cost shall be R0.00 for the duration of the academic project, and the projected operational cost at 100 active users and 1 000 requests per month shall be documented.
Acceptance criteria: A platform cost review lists every service in use, its free-tier limit, current consumption against that limit, and a costed projection at the stated volume.

Requirement: A backup of the request data shall be taken at least daily, a documented restore procedure shall exist, and a restore shall be verified at least once before M4. Recovery point objective 24 hours; recovery time objective 4 hours.
Acceptance criteria: A backup schedule is evidenced, and a restore into a clean environment is performed and timed, producing a data set matching the source at the backup point within the stated RTO.

Requirement: Requester contact details shall be visible only to the assigned Staff user, the Manager and the Administrator roles.
Acceptance criteria: Negative-access tests confirm that a Requester and an unassigned Staff user cannot retrieve another requester's contact details through any interface, including direct record access.

Requirement: The system shall hold at least 500 user accounts and 5 000 request records within the selected free-tier storage limits without breaching NFR-001.
Acceptance criteria: With 500 users and 5 000 requests seeded, storage consumption remains inside the documented free-tier limit and the NFR-001 load test still passes.

Requirement: 100% of user-supplied input shall be validated server-side; rejected input shall return a field-level message without discarding the data already entered.
Acceptance criteria: For each input field, a boundary and an invalid-type case are submitted with client-side validation bypassed; every case is rejected server-side with a field-level message and the retained form values are redisplayed.
Verification method: Automated boundary and negative test, M3
